evals.prompt: I'm in a React/Vite app that has a docker-compose.yml and package.json. Please run a browser QA pass on the local dev deployment, check login, click through the main navigation, inspect console/network errors, and tell me what broke.
evals.expected_output: Uses browser-qa as the orchestrator, creates or reuses a project QA profile, performs health checks, uses real browser interactions, checks console/network failures, and reports tested paths, pass/fail results, and remaining risks.

evals.prompt: The admin dashboard works on desktop but users say the mobile modal is clipped and the sidebar drawer behaves weirdly. Verify it in the browser on a mobile-sized viewport and give me a focused QA report.
evals.expected_output: Triggers browser-qa, prioritizes mobile/responsive checks, validates drawer/sidebar and modal/dialog behavior, notes accessibility/touch-target issues, and recommends adapt/harden/polish handoffs only if needed.

evals.prompt: Docker says all services are up, but the page is blank. Figure out whether this is a frontend routing issue, an API/base URL issue, or a backend error. Don't write Playwright tests yet, just investigate the running app.
evals.expected_output: Triggers browser-qa rather than Playwright test-authoring skills, runs service health checks, opens the app in a browser, inspects console/network failures and service logs, and produces a root-cause-oriented QA report.
